observations: Photo 0: Front view of a white Canon DSLR camera with a lens attached. The lens cap is black with 'Canon' written on it. The camera body has 'Canon' branding visible. A hand holds the camera.
Photo 1: Back view of the camera showing the LCD screen, control buttons (MENU, INFO, Av, SET, etc.), and the 'Canon' logo on the bottom bezel. The screen is off and reflects the hand holding it.
Photo 2: Side view of the camera showing the 'EOS 100D' model name engraved on the body. The lens is attached, and the camera body is white. The background shows a metal railing and tiled floor.

claims.claim: The Canon EOS 100D (Rebel SL1) is an ultra-compact, lightweight 18-megapixel APS-C DSLR designed for...
claims.evidence: Photo 2 shows 'EOS 100D' engraved on the camera body, which is consistent with the Rebel SL1 model. The camera appears compact and lightweight, and the 18-megapixel APS-C sensor is standard for this model.

risks.risk: The camera may not power on or may have a non-functional LCD screen.
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the camera powered on with the screen displaying an image or menu.

risks.risk: The lens may be damaged or non-functional (e.g., scratches, fungus, or internal issues).
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the lens glass and barrel, showing no scratches, haze, or damage.
risks.if_unproven: priced as lens may be damaged

risks.risk: The camera may have internal damage or missing components (e.g., battery, charger, strap).
risks.proof: A photo showing the battery, charger, and any included accessories.

proof_requests: Video or photo of the camera powered on with the LCD screen working.
Close-up photo of the lens glass and barrel to check for damage.
Photo of the battery and charger included with the camera.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
